newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eiffel Tower stays closed by strike.
newsitem.headline: Eiffel Tower stays closed by strike.

text.p: The Eiffel Tower stayed closed for a second day on Thursday as management met workers to try to end a strike at the Paris monument, visited by about 5.5 million people a year.
Hundreds of dismayed tourists were turned away from the base of the 320-metre (1,050 ft) tower, completed in 1889.
"Management is holding a meeting with the representatives of the staff. The tower is closed," an official at the management company said.

Workers went on strike in protest at the sacking of a man accused by a British tourist of manhandling her last month when she suffered vertigo and tried to get out of a lift as the doors were about to close.
The Eiffel Tower, rated the world's tallest building until the completion of the Empire State skyscraper in New York in 1931, calls itself the most visited paying monument in the world.
